title: Plan: replace bd with kb-native issue tracker (drop dolt)
design:
# PLAN: Replace beads (bd) with a kb-native issue tracker (drop dolt)

## Motivation

bd works conceptually (DAG deps, epics, ready/blocked, the review/dispatch
workflows) but the dolt backend is an operational tax — this session alone:
breaker false-open under load, migration wedge on dirty working sets, a 0.60→1.0
schema upgrade, and a 6-database migration. bd is also far larger than we use
(60+ commands: wisps, molecules, swarms, gates, federation, merge-slots,
compaction). And the kb-7g9.5 "ingest bd into kb" approach DUPLICATES content
(mirror of dolt in kb).

Goal: make **kb the source of truth** for issues — issues live in kb's single
SQLite DB (no server, no dolt), are vector+FTS searchable, and open AND closed
issues are surfaced into agent context via the existing hooks. Keep the parts we
value (DAG dependency tracking, epics/children, ready/blocked, the
expert-review/implementation-review/dispatch workflows). Drop dolt and bd's
complexity. Supersedes kb-7g9.5 (ingest-mirror) and kb-7g9.6 (surfacing) and
folds in kb-k3i (domain-aware open-issue injection).

## Investigation summary (verified against ../beads + kb sources)

bd data model: issues(id, title, description, design, status, priority,
issue_type, parent via hierarchical id, assignee, timestamps, close_reason,
metadata) + dependencies(issue_id, depends_on_id, type) + labels + comments +
events. DAG types that affect ready/blocked: `blocks`, `parent-child` (children
inherit parent's blocked state), plus niche `conditional-blocks`/`waits-for`.
`bd ready` = status in (open,in_progress) AND is_blocked=0 (denormalized,
recomputed by transitive closure); `bd blocked` = is_blocked=1 + active blockers.
IDs: `<prefix>-<hash>` roots + `<parent>.<N>` children (child_counters table).

dolt coupling (the drop target): MySQL-protocol sql-server, branches, push/pull
replication, dolt history/compaction/flatten, the circuit breaker. ALL of
ready/blocked, dep traversal, label/comment/event logging is pure SQL that runs
identically on plain SQLite. The thin dolt layer is droppable.

Workflow contract (the ~18 ops the workflows actually use):
- planning: `create --type=epic --design-file=PATH`; `create --type=task --parent=EPIC`
- expert-review: `show EPIC` → read `.design` (file PATH, not content); rejects a
  plan whose deferral references lack a bd-ID.
- implementation-review: `show EPIC`, list children.
- /dispatch: `show EPIC`; `list --status=open --parent=EPIC`; `update TASK --claim`
  (ATOMIC, no double-claim); `close TASK`; `dep list EPIC` filtered to
  `discovered-from`.
- the discovered-from discipline: `create --deps=discovered-from:EPIC`; query it.
- project-manager (read-only): list/blocked/stale/search/stats/children.
Everything else bd exposes (wisps, molecules, gates, federation, dolt, compact)
is UNUSED by our workflows → dropped.

kb substrate (verified): SQLite + sqlite-vec + FTS5 at ~/.cache/kb/knowledge.db.
The EntityRepository pattern (kb/entities/) already adds typed entities with
their own `<entity>`, `<entity>_vec`, `<entity>_fts` tables + role-typed junction
tables. ConceptRepository (kb/entities/concepts.py) is an exact template: status
enum, project scope, add/get/list/search(vector), supersede, and
`concept_theorems`/`concept_findings` role-typed edges == the dependency-edge
pattern. HybridSearch (vector+FTS+RRF) is reusable for issue search.
open_issues_surface.py currently shells `bd list --status=open --json`; switching
it to a kb table is a localized change.

## Architecture: kb-native tracker ("kb issues")

Single SQLite DB (kb's existing knowledge.db), WAL mode, no server. New kb entity:

- `kb/entities/issues.py` → `IssuesRepository` (modeled on ConceptRepository).
- Tables: `issues`, `issues_vec` (description embedding), `issues_fts`, `issue_deps`.
- `issues` columns (the bd-essential subset, NOT the wisp/molecule/gate/federation
  bloat): id, type (task|bug|feature|epic|chore|spike|decision), status
  (open|in_progress|blocked|closed), priority (0-4), parent_id, title,
  description, design_file (path), assignee, close_reason, project, tags(JSON),
  created_at, updated_at, started_at, closed_at, closed_by_session.
  (bd's extra statuses — defer/pin/hook — and defer-until scheduling are dropped,
  unused.)
- `issue_deps` columns: issue_id, depends_on_id, type
  (blocks|parent-child|discovered-from|related|supersedes), created_at, created_by.
  ready/blocked-affecting subset = {blocks, parent-child}.
- ready/blocked: computed on-demand via recursive SQL (an issue is READY iff
  status in (open,in_progress) AND no open `blocks`-blocker AND its parent (if
  any) is not blocked). No denormalized is_blocked initially (hundreds of issues
  → fast); add a materialized column later only if a query is slow.
- ID scheme: KEEP bd's scheme for continuity — `<prefix>-<hex>` roots +
  `<parent>.<N>` children — so existing ids (kb-7g9, kb-7g9.5) and all
  plan-file / discovered-from / kb-id references stay valid post-migration.

## CLI: a bd-compatible shim (so workflows/hooks are UNCHANGED)

We do NOT reimplement bd's 60 commands — only the ~18-op contract. Provide:
- `kb issue <add|show|list|update|close|dep|ready|blocked|search>` (native).
- a thin `bd`-compatible front that maps the contract subcommands
  (`bd create/show/update --claim/close/list --status --parent/dep add/dep list/
  ready/blocked/search`) onto `kb issue`, emitting the SAME `--json` shapes the
  hooks/workflows parse. Installed AS `bd` (replacing the npm binary) so
  CLAUDE.md, /dispatch, the review agents, and the surfacing hooks need no
  command changes — only their backend changes.
- Claim atomicity: `UPDATE issues SET status='in_progress', assignee=? WHERE id=?
  AND status IN ('open','blocked')` → rowcount==1 means claimed (SQLite WAL,
  single-host multi-process safe).

## Surfacing (the user's core want)

- `open_issues_surface.py`: query the kb `issues` table directly (no server);
  ADD vector search (embed the prompt → issues_vec) instead of pure
  token-overlap; surface OPEN and recently-CLOSED issues ([OPEN-ISSUE]/
  [RESOLVED-ISSUE]) — closed issues are prior-art ("this was already
  done/decided"). Folds in kb-k3i (domain-aware injection).
- `compose_time_check.py`: add an [OPEN-ISSUE]/[RESOLVED-ISSUE] advisory class
  from the issues table at compute-intent (Agent/Bash dispatch).
- The embedding-down path already degrades to FTS (kb-zma) — issue surfacing
  inherits it.

## Migration (dolt → kb, one-time, fidelity-preserving)

Per project DB (kb, am_rs, braidinfer, vllm, llamacpp, exterior_algebra):
`bd export --json` (or direct SQL over the dolt server) → an importer that
inserts into kb `issues` + `issue_deps`, PRESERVING ids, parent links, dep types,
status (incl closed), design_file, timestamps. Closed issues imported too (prior
art). Verify counts + a sample diff. THEN retire dolt + bd.

## Workflow adaptation

The bd-shim means expert-review / implementation-review / /dispatch /
the discovered-from discipline / block-followup-without-bd-id run UNCHANGED (same
commands, kb backend). CLAUDE.md "Planning and Review (Beads-Based)" → reworded to
"kb-based" (mechanical). project-manager's audit commands (stale/blocked/lint/
find-duplicates) map to kb issue queries; the niche ones it can lose.

## What we DROP

dolt entirely (server, branches, push/pull, history, compaction, breaker,
migrations); wisps/ephemeral, molecules/swarm/gates, federation/source_system,
conditional-blocks/waits-for, merge-slot, the 40+ niche commands. If a dropped
feature is later needed, it is added to the kb tracker deliberately.

## Phases (each a child task under the epic)

1. IssuesRepository + schema (issues/_vec/_fts/issue_deps) + id scheme + CRUD +
   vector/FTS search (clone ConceptRepository).
2. ready/blocked recursive SQL + dep add/list + claim-atomic update.
3. `kb issue` CLI + the `bd`-compatible shim (18-op contract, matching --json
   shapes); ship behind a flag, validate against the live workflows.
4. Migration importer (dolt export → kb issues, all 6 DBs, id/dep/status fidelity)
   + a verification harness (counts + sample diff).
5. Surfacing hooks: open_issues_surface + compose_time_check → kb issues, vector +
   open/closed.
6. Workflow/doc updates: CLAUDE.md "Beads-Based"→"kb-based"; confirm dispatch +
   both review agents work on the shim.
7. Cutover: switch `bd` to the shim, run the migration, retire dolt.service on
   tardis + uninstall @beads/bd + archive .beads/. Tests green; one full
   plan→review→dispatch→close loop on the new backend.

## Risks / mitigations

- Concurrency (multi-agent, one host): SQLite WAL + short transactions +
  claim-via-UPDATE-rowcount. bd used dolt MVCC; WAL handles single-host
  multi-process. (Multi-HOST sync — which dolt push/pull gave — is dropped; all
  agents are on this host. If multi-host returns, revisit.)
- ready/blocked perf: recursive SQL per `bd ready`; fine at our scale, materialize
  later if needed.
- Shim output fidelity: the hooks/workflows parse specific `--json` shapes; Phase
  3 must reproduce them exactly (enumerate from the contract).
- Migration fidelity: ids/deps/status must round-trip or plan-file/discovered-from
  references break — verified by the Phase-4 harness before cutover.
- Bootstrapping irony: this plan's epic is tracked in bd; it migrates into kb at
  cutover.

## Follow-ups (in bd)

- kb-7g9.5: superseded by this epic (ingest-mirror replaced by source-of-truth); re-linked/closed when the epic is created.
- kb-7g9.6 and kb-k3i: surfacing work folds into Phase 5 of this epic.

title: Semantic prior-art surfacing — stop blind reimplementation (kb + bd + code; 3-tier lineage)
description: Pre-emptive surfacing of prior art at act-time (PreToolUse Edit/Write/Task + UserPromptSubmit + Stop) so agents see existing findings, bd issues, and CODE before reimplementing. Engine exists (kb search = semantic over findings). Needs: multi-language code ingest (Extractor seam + prune + content-addressed identity), bd->kb ingest, and a 3-tier function-version model — A: normalized-AST structural hash (exact lineage through rename/move/delete-readd, embedding-free); C: shingle+MinHash/LSH containment (inline/extract + fragment reuse, embedding-free, IDF-weighted); B: embeddings (semantic rewrite, ash-gated). Current + history corpora, git-metadata-independent (distrust git rename detection). Function-first surfacing, file-as-metadata, LSP-composing. Plan: ~/.claude/plans/PLAN-semantic-prior-art-surfacing.md. Folds in kb-5ms, kb-mrl, kb-7lp, kb-k3i, kb-zma. ash:8081 currently down (mes reload) — Tier-B pieces gated on live test.
design:
# PLAN: Semantic prior-art surfacing — stop blind reimplementation

Epic: kb-7g9
Goal: at the moment an agent is about to act (write code, dispatch, edit), pre-emptively surface
existing **kb findings, bd issues, and CODE** that already do what it's about to do — so it stops
reimplementing / re-deriving / contradicting prior work. The user's stated failure mode: "I've
utterly failed to get Claude to do pre-emptive research before blindly trudging into the side of a
mountain; these hooks are the fix."

## Files read in full (research, this plan)
- `~/Projects/ai/kb/scripts/ingest_python.py` (the code-ingest path to generalize)
- `~/Projects/ai/kb/kb/facade.py` `add_python_symbol` (embed-on-add: `embed_text = "module.name: signature docstring"`)
- `~/Projects/ai/kb/kb_mcp_core.py` `kb_search` (semantic similarity over findings via `kb.search`)
- `~/Projects/ai/kb/kb/core/embedding.py` (llama.cpp `/embedding` endpoint, token-embeddings mean-pooled, 4096-dim)
- `~/Projects/ai/kb/scripts/hooks/post-commit-secular.sh` (current re-ingest trigger)
- DB schema via sqlite (`findings`/`lean_theorems` populated + `_vec`; `python_symbols`/`scripts`/`concepts` empty; **no bd table**)

## Verified substrate (what exists / what's missing)
- **`kb search` is semantic** today (embed query → `findings_vec` sqlite-vec → similarity). Engine works; the surfacing hooks just token-match instead of calling it.
- Per-corpus `_vec` + per-entity search is the existing architecture (`findings`/`lean_theorems`/`scripts`/`concepts`/`theorems`).
- `add_python_symbol` **already embeds** per-symbol (`module.name: signature docstring`) — downstream is language-neutral.
- **Gaps:** ingest is **commit-only, add-only, NO PRUNE** (deleted/renamed symbols leave stale rows → would surface non-existent code). Git hooks are sparse (only `claude` has post-commit; no post-merge/checkout/rewrite; target repos have none). **bd is not in the kb** (cannot be vector-searched). Code corpora (`python_symbols`/`scripts`) are empty.
- **ash:8081 embedding server is currently down** (mes-researcher amdgpu reload) → the embedding-down STOP gate (kb-zma) is load-bearing; semantic surfacing must hard-STOP / FTS-fallback, never silently return empty.

## Architecture

### Corpus expansion (prerequisite)
- **kb-7g9.1 — multi-language `kb ingest`:** factor a per-language **Extractor** (Python `ast` reused; Rust/C++/TS via **tree-sitter**; **ctags** fallback) feeding one embed/write pipeline. `python_symbols`→`code_symbols` (+`language`). **Add PRUNE** (`--files X` deletes vanished symbols; `--deleted F`). Content-addressed `symbol_id = hash(project,language,qualname)` + `content_hash`. Physics extras (`RETIRED_SYMBOLS`/`CANONICAL_FILES`/`frame_hint`/notations) → per-project `.claude/kb-ingest.json`.
- **kb-7g9.5 — bd→kb ingest:** embed bd `title+description+design` into a `bd_issues` corpus (+`_vec`), synced on `bd create/update/close` (pattern: `bd_close_reingest.py`) + periodic resync. (Answers the user's explicit question: **yes**, bd must be embedded to vector-search it.)

### Three identity/lineage tiers over function-versions (the hard-cases solution)
Distrust git rename/path metadata entirely; re-derive identity from CONTENT over the commit DAG.
- **kb-7g9.2 — Tier A: normalized-AST structural hash** (embedding-free). Alpha-rename own-name+locals, strip comments/format, KEEP calls+literals → hash blind to name/path/position/cosmetic. Tracks a function exactly through **rename, file move, top↔bottom move, delete-then-readd** with no git rename detection. Cluster versions into logical-function lineages; accumulate provenance timeline (names/paths/commits/status).
- **kb-7g9.3 — Tier C: sub-function shingle + MinHash/LSH containment** (embedding-free). Normalized AST statement-shingles (k-gram + order-insensitive set) → MinHash signature → LSH index. **Asymmetric containment** surfaces **extract** (helper ⊆ original) and **inline** (fragment inside bigger fn) regardless of boundary or git hygiene. **IDF/document-frequency** down-weights boilerplate (ubiquitous patterns self-suppress). This is the answer to "vector search isn't fuzzy" — whole-function NN is too coarse for boundary-unstable refactors; containment over fragments is the right tool.
- **kb-7g9.4 — Tier B: function/block embeddings** (ash-gated). Embed `qualname:signature:docstring` (+ block-level for migrated subspans) for "different code, same intent" (catches syntactic rewrites that A/C miss). **Current tier** (working tree, mutable, pruned to HEAD/branch) + **History tier** (deleted/reverted/branch-tip versions, content-deduped, provenance-tagged). Gated on ash + the embedding-down STOP.

Tiers compose: A=exact whole-fn, C=fragment/inline-extract, B=semantic rewrite. A and C are **embedding-free and ash-outage-immune** — the hardest cases (rename/move/delete-readd, inline/extract) are the cheap deterministic part; only B needs ash.

### Surfacing (kb-7g9.6)
- **`kb surface "<text>" --sources findings,bd,code --limit 3`** — embed once, query `findings_vec` + `bd_vec` + code tiers (B cosine + C containment + A exact), merge.
- Hook on **UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Edit|Write|Task) + Stop** (the act-moments; PreToolUse Edit/Write is the "walking into the mountain" point).
- **Function-first, file-as-metadata, LSP-composing:** output `qualname(sig) — "docstring" [module]`; file:line is metadata for the LSP jump. Index = semantic discovery; LSP = precise navigation. Agents see *functions*, not files.
- **Layered triggers** (cheapest-first): (1) WRONG→RIGHT anti-pattern docs in the project persona/API.md; (2) project `reinvention-guard` pattern→symbol map (deterministic, catches trivial inline-math reinvention embeddings miss); (3) semantic + containment surface.
- Reliability: `_seen` dedup (`code:<symbol_id>`), suppress-surface allowlist (e.g. "assume Transformers attention works"), embedding-down STOP (kb-zma).

## Phases
- **P1 (no ash):** kb-7g9.1 ingest generalization + PRUNE + content-id; kb-7g9.2 Tier-A structural-hash lineage. Anti-pattern docs + reinvention-guard (kb-7g9.6 layers 1–2). Immediate value, embedding-free.
- **P2 (no ash):** kb-7g9.3 Tier-C shingle/containment + IDF. Full git triggers (post-commit/merge/checkout/rewrite) → current-tier always-fresh + prune.
- **P3 (ash):** kb-7g9.4 Tier-B embeddings + current/history corpora; `kb surface` multi-source + the Edit/Write semantic surface hook. **LIVE-TEST gated** (kb-7g9.7).
- **P4:** kb-7g9.5 bd→kb ingest + `--sources bd`; kb-k3i domain-aware injection; kb-mrl/kb-7lp semantic kb-context/UserPromptSubmit.

## Live-test gates (on ash:8081 return — mes-researcher reloading)
kb-7g9.7: confirm ash GGUF is **code-capable** (vs prose); calibrate similarity/containment thresholds, structural-hash normalization aggressiveness (over-collapse vs under-link), shingle k + min-fragment + IDF cutoff. Validate against the 3 measured exterior_algebra duplications (audie #5087) + the import-stat discoverability method (audie).

## Follow-ups (in bd)
- kb-7g9.1: multi-language ingest + prune + content-id (prerequisite).
- kb-7g9.2: Tier-A structural-hash lineage.
- kb-7g9.3: Tier-C shingle/MinHash/LSH containment + IDF.
- kb-7g9.4: Tier-B embeddings + current/history corpora.
- kb-7g9.5: bd→kb ingest.
- kb-7g9.6: kb surface CLI + function-first/LSP surfacing + layered Edit/Write triggers.
- kb-7g9.7: prereqs/calibration (ash code-model live check, AST-normalizer, granularity tuning).
- kb-5ms: code/library-API semantic index (subsumed by kb-7g9.1+.4+.6 — close as dup or keep as the umbrella).
- kb-mrl: kb-context.sh semantic injection (P4).
- kb-7lp: UserPromptSubmit semantic kb query (P4).
- kb-k3i: open_issues_surface domain-aware bd injection (P4).
- kb-zma: embedding-down detection/STOP gate (cross-cutting reliability; required by Tier B + kb surface).

## Notation
- "function-version" = one (function, commit) content state; identity is content-addressed, not name/path.
- Tiers: A=structural-hash (exact), C=shingle/containment (fragment), B=embedding (semantic).
- "current tier" = working-tree state; "history tier" = deleted/reverted/other-branch versions.

title: kb-context.sh: semantic-query injection, not recent-ids (user expects vector-query surfacing)
description:
audie audit (bridge #5073): kb-context.sh injects the 3 most-RECENT kb ids by project (recency, not relevance). User BELIEVES semantic injection happens (vector-query the conversation -> surface relevant entries e.g. 9xe). It does not. Fix: kb-context.sh should run 'kb search --project

--limit 5' to vector-query. Hybrid-workspace projects (exterior_algebra) get wrong-domain noise (kernel entries for a transformer-research session) under the recency window. High-value correctness/expectation gap.
notes: (see code-index bd) audie #5089 git-archaeology REFUTES copy-hypothesis: the 3 dup scripts are INDEPENDENT re-derivations of ~2-line math (alpha=h@v1; h_perp=h-outer(alpha,v1)), not template copies. Library-first rule was present + function findable; agents inlined trivial math without looking. DESIGN REFINEMENT for the code index: pure name/signature embedding similarity may MISS trivial inline-math reinvention. Add (a) project-configurable REINVENTION-GUARD: pattern->symbol map (ast-grep/literal: 'alpha = h @ v1','h_perp = h -','def extract_v1','h[0]/h[0].norm()' -> decompose_hidden_states/extract_v1) checked at PreToolUse Edit/Write on the about-to-be-written content; (b) WRONG->RIGHT anti-pattern examples in project API.md/persona ('if you write X, use Y') — strongest deterrent for simple-math reinvention. Semantic index catches concept similarity; pattern-guard catches known shapes deterministically; anti-pattern docs are the cheap immediate fix.

title: kb-dev: EMBEDDING-DOWN detection hook — announce degradation + FTS fallback + optional hard-STOP gate
description: User-ordered (2026-06-07, after the silent-blind re-derivation failure). ash:8081 down = kb-search + [STRUCTURAL-FACT]/[ALREADY-CODIFIED]/[NOTATION] surfacing go SILENT; agents forge ahead blind and re-derive. SIGNAL (cheap): curl -s -m2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://ash:8081/ != 200 (4ms when up); also kb 503 / 'Queued:' (add fell to pending). IMPLEMENT: (1) ANNOUNCE — a SessionStart + PreToolUse-on-compute-intent check that, when ash unreachable, injects a LOUD '[EMBEDDING DOWN: kb-search/surfacing BLIND — STOP retrieval-dependent compute, mechanical-only]' line (cache health w/ short TTL, e.g. 60s, to avoid per-call latency); (2) FALLBACK — the surfacing hooks (structural_facts, findings_fts, notations) are sqlite-FTS/exact-match indexed and do NOT need embeddings: make them fall back to FTS when embeddings are down so they STILL fire (degraded but not blind); (3) optional hard-STOP gate per the global CLAUDE.md 'EMBEDDING-SERVER-DOWN HARD STOP' section. Cross-ref: global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md KB section, kb meta-failure kb-20260607-192654-3ad69e.
notes: SLOW-degrade landed (this session): added per-call embed timeout; HybridSearch query embed uses KB_SEARCH_EMBED_TIMEOUT (10s) so a SLOW-but-responding server degrades to FTS in seconds (was up to 180s). kb-context.sh SessionStart search bounded (8s embed, 0 retries, timeout 12 outer). Per-prompt surfacing (kb-prompt-surface.py) already had an 8s subprocess cap (skip on slow/down). Plus earlier: FTS fallback on failure, ash_health.sh probes router /health (not /), kb-context SessionStart announce -> stdout. kb-zma CORE COMPLETE: parts (1)announce (2)FTS-fallback (3)hard-STOP all done. ONLY residual = pure-mechanical-edit carve-out for prior-art-gate (obviated now that search is runnable-degraded; lower priority, could spin to its own issue).

title: kb-dev: lean_work_queue Stop-hook iteration (dogfood bugs #4532) + startup token diet (bd-prime trim, mathlib-contributions generation, proofs_suspicious fold)
description: A. lean_work_queue (tip's proactive-proving Stop hook, #4518->#4523 accepted full): fix the dogfood bugs tip filed #4532 — (1) queue-defer subcommand does not exist in kb.py (defer menu unexecutable); (2) row-id display; (3) READINESS-INFERENCE (default DESIGN-NEEDED + the -- CONTRACT-READY: marker); (4) agent-cap awareness; (5) session defer-cache; (6) lake-check --include-working-tree (worktree can't see untracked — bounds new-file concurrency); (7) gap-claim citation mandate + rot lint (#4558/#4559); PLAN-DIVERGENCE auto-flag on old-bead rows (#4527). B. startup token diet (secular-constraints bd onr0): bd-prime SessionStart output ~31K tok EVERY session -> counts+top-N; mathlib-contributions.md 62K -> git-log-generated index; proofs_suspicious.md 26K -> fold into lean-audit/suspect surface. Principle: every cut names where content went. Cross-ref: secular-constraints onr0, bridge #4561/#4523/#4532.

title: kb-dev: hooks-over-instructions cadence steps 2-7 (FRAME_PROVENANCE wiring + the CLAUDE.md removal classes)
description: User doctrine: hooks > sweeping instructions; narrowly-scoped surfacing at need-time. Negotiation #4565->#4566 (8 YES/1 PARTIAL/1 SPLIT). DONE: step1 sigma* pointer (049a5f8), step4 GK symlink (archie). REMAINING (per-class, content moves to certified_data FIRST then archie cuts CLAUDE.md prose only after observed firing): step2 FRAME_PROVENANCE -> wire python_symbols.frame_hint surfacing into compose_time_check + check_symbols (emmy landed the dict 28f6ba3 + facts.py 98bff02 — DATA READY, just the ~40-line hook wiring left); step3 object glossary (M_HF/tau2/M_vierbein/dilaton_*) -> notations rows (archie supplies dict); step5 mass/gram route-retired -> python_symbols RETIRED rows (R_chi/S_had/detPhiNative + kb-ids); step6 anti-pattern table SPLIT (file-content->Edit/Write lint; prose->Stop hook ~8 phrases; semantic->stays); step7 personas Stop-surface rule files. Full per-class assessment: secular-constraints bd onr0 + bridge #4566.
notes: step6 DONE (anti-pattern table SPLIT -> hooks): FILE-CONTENT = new hooks/guards/block-box-drawing.py (PreToolUse Edit|Write, blocks U+2500-U+257F box-drawing in authored content; excludes block-elements/statusline bar). OUTPUT = block-unprompted-deferral.sh BOX category (box-drawing in assistant response text). PROSE rows already enforced by that Stop hook's READ/PAUSE/BRAG (speculation hedges, 'want me to look', 'probably already covers', self-praise). STAY SEMANTIC (too FP-prone or judgment): 'promising/straightforward/just needs', conflict-averaging, label-match, intent-free-test, DFR, grep-blind-audit, out-of-scope-model, epic-without-review, notation-conflict, CLAUDE.md-wins. Suite 53/53; settings PreToolUse[Write|Edit] wired; verifier 63. Per doctrine, the CLAUDE.md box-drawing prose row is cut only AFTER observed firing. REMAINING kb-6hn: step2 (FRAME_PROVENANCE wiring, data ready), step3/5 (notations/RETIRED rows, need archie dicts), step7 (persona Stop-surface).

title: P7: ingest ALL existing beads (6 project DBs) via P4 importer; run fidelity harness
bridge-thread -> kb ingest (vector-searchable team memory); experiential = curation+surfacing, not a new type
description: Reframe (per maintainer): the kb ALREADY IS the shared multi-agent memory (vector-searchable, cross-agent). 'Code as Agent Harness' (2605.18747 §3.2) distinguishes experiential vs semantic memory, but in OUR stack that collapses into the kb 'type' field — an experiential 'lesson' is just a failure/correction/success finding whose content is 'tried X -> failed (Y) -> fix Z' rather than a static fact. The CLAUDE.md Anti-Patterns table is the hand-promoted subset; kb-mrl reinvention-guard is the deterministic surface. So NO new memory subsystem + NO new 'experience' type. The ONE net-new capability: ingest the bridge (~/.agent-bridge/messages.jsonl) into the kb so resolved threads (--needs-reply resolutions, CLEAR/findings, design negotiations) become vector-searchable team memory instead of evaporating. Scope: (1) bridge->kb ingest — thread-aware (group reply chains via reply_to), dedup, domain/sender tags, skip ephemeral wake/ack/announce noise; (2) surfacing weights failure/correction (experiential) findings at task-start via existing kb-7g9 hooks. Distinct from §5.2.4 shared-STATE (coordination/consistency); this is the LEARNING layer. Depends-on/extends kb-7g9 bd->kb ingest + kb-mrl.

title: Relevant-but-UNEXPLORED surfacing: per-agent explored-set + on-topic code the agent hasn't opened
description: User requirement: proactively surface code relevant to the agent's CURRENT work that it HASN'T explored yet (not just 'don't reimplement'). Mechanism: EXPLORED-SET per agent = files/symbols Read or Edited this session (derive from session tool history; reuse _seen/dedupe-file-reads infra). WORKING-SET/topic = recent edits + current file + dispatch prompt -> query. SURFACE = top code symbols semantically/containment-relevant to working-set MINUS explored-set, ranked by relevance x unexplored x importance (public API / high fan-in). Especially surface relevant SUBMODULES the agent hasn't imported/opened (audie: model/ found 527x but core/eval/data missed). Triggers: session-start ('relevant areas you have not opened') + on-topic during work. Inverse of dedup: dedup suppresses seen; this actively surfaces relevant-UNSEEN.

title: P0 reliability: supervise ash:8081 embedding server + embedding-down STOP (pairs kb-zma)
description: ash:8081 (embeddings) is the same failure class as the dolt server: unsupervised shared backend whose death silently disables a core capability (semantic surfacing goes blind). Supervise (systemd Restart=always) + the embedding-down STOP/FTS-fallback gate (kb-zma) so surfacing hard-STOPs rather than returning silent-empty. Surfacing Tier B + kb surface depend on this.

title: Provenance-guard trigger: code introduced by patch/commit X — revert, don't layer
description: mes #5094 (0069->0071 patch-of-a-patch, reverted). At PreToolUse Edit/Write attribute edited lines/symbol to introducing commit/patch (git-blame vs base, or scan patch-stack 0NNN-*.patch unified-diff hunks) -> WARN revert-not-layer. Rides Tier-A git-provenance. Embedding-free. Specialization: linux-p2p 0NNN-*.patch. #4 same-field-many-patches=cross-patch dup signal. mes offered to co-define the attribution scan.

title: Tier B: function/block embeddings + current vs history corpora (ash-gated)
description: Embed qualname:signature:docstring (+ block-level for migrated subspans) for semantic 'different code same intent'. Current tier (working tree, mutable, pruned to HEAD/branch) + History tier (deleted/reverted/branch-tip versions, content-deduped, provenance-tagged). Gated on ash:8081 + the embedding-down STOP (kb-zma). LIVE-TEST on ash return: code-model capability, similarity/threshold calibration, containment vs cosine behavior.

title: Surfacing: kb surface multi-source CLI + function-first/LSP-composing format + layered Edit/Write triggers
description: kb surface '<text>' --sources findings,bd,code --limit 3 (embed once, query findings_vec+bd_vec+code tiers, merge by sim/containment). Hook on UserPromptSubmit+PreToolUse(Edit|Write|Task)+Stop. Function-first output (qualname+sig+docstring; file:line metadata for LSP jump). Layered triggers: (1) WRONG->RIGHT anti-pattern docs in persona, (2) project reinvention-guard pattern->symbol map, (3) semantic+containment surface. _seen dedup (code:<symbol_id>), suppress-surface allowlist, embedding-down gate.
notes: AGENT FEEDBACK: Edit/Write ranking UNANIMOUS (a)existing FUNCTION >> (b)reverted/provenance (very-high sim only) > (c)bd PLAN (file in scope) > (d)kb finding. FORMAT: name(sig)->Ret [file:line], one line, function-first, never file-only. COUNT tiered: Bash top-1 high-bar-or-silent; Edit/Write/Stop top-3. Strict per-session dedup load-bearing. SUPPRESS non-code bash + READ + self-match. Past-experiment surfacing at prompt (722-script problem) via kb entries.

title: UserPromptSubmit: semantic kb query on the incoming prompt (inject matching ids)
description: audie audit (#5073): UserPromptSubmit runs kb-flush-pending + bridge-recv but never queries kb with the user's message. Prompts like 'prefill order'/'DAG KV cache' get no kb injection though matching entries exist. Fix: UserPromptSubmit step 'kb search <prompt-truncated> --limit 3' -> 1-line 'Relevant KB: ...'; emit nothing if kb down/empty. Pairs with the kb-context.sh semantic fix.
notes: mes-researcher bridge #5149 feedback (2026-06-09): [OPEN-BD] surfacing WORKED (put exterior_algebra-eqf3/ub49 in PreToolUse context, prevented a dup bd) but agent cited from the TRUNCATED one-line summary and kept doing own analysis; only ran 'bd show' late. Gap: surfaced bead-ID treated as citation token, not 'STOP and retrieve/claim the existing design.' Ask: (a) PreToolUse/Edit hook that BLOCKS Write until a topic-matching surfaced bead is retrieved this session (like followup-bd-id gate); (b) inject the bead's design-file PATH not just truncated title; (c) session-state marker 'N surfaced-but-unretrieved beads relevant to current work.' Real payoff: late retrieval surfaced a load-bearing discrepancy (landed patch 0117 flat slot offset vs ub49 verified gang-indexed offset). Design the retrieve-and-connect enforcement on top of OPEN-BD surfacing.

title: open_issues_surface.py: domain-aware bd injection (single tracker, 2 workstreams — kernel P0/P1 crowd out research)
description: audie audit (#5073): no SessionStart hook surfaces the main open bd queue; session-followups.sh only catches discovered-from on recently-closed epics. Fresh agents never see 40+ open issues/epics unless they run bd ready. Fix: SessionStart hook 'bd ready --json | head -N' -> compact ids+titles injection. Note overlap: open_issues_surface.py surfaces bd on Task DISPATCH (token-match), not at SessionStart.
notes: AGENT FEEDBACK #5103-5106 (audie/am-rs-dev/lisa/braidinfer): current [OPEN-BD] is untargeted rotation of open P1s on non-code bash = NOISE; banner-blind after ~3. Missing axis is RELEVANCE-TO-CURRENT-WORK not domain (braidinfer: deep in 50gg.6, never saw 50gg.*). Fixes: gate on CONTENT match to call target not recency/priority; prompt-vocabulary classifier (audie); SUPPRESS pure-IO bash + READ + self/own-active-epic; top-1 high-bar on Bash else silent.
